text: Atlas is operated by the Platform Reliability team. The service handles authentication traffic.
Atlas Analytics is operated by the Developer Productivity team. The service produces internal reporting dashboards.
Platform Reliability maintains the Borealis storage system for production customer profile data.
Platform Reliability maintains the Aurora storage system for legacy reporting workloads.
For the production Borealis service, full backups run every Sunday. Incremental backups run every six hours.
For Borealis staging, incremental backups run every four hours to speed up recovery testing.
Aurora performs incremental backups every twelve hours for legacy reporting data.
Developer Productivity maintains the Cirrus worker platform for production asynchronous workloads.
For the production Cirrus worker platform, failed jobs are retried at most five times before dead-letter handling. Jobs that exhaust retries are sent to the CIRRUS-DLQ dead-letter queue.
For Cirrus staging, failed jobs are retried at most three times to keep tests fast. Exhausted staging jobs are written to a temporary test sink.
Helios is operated by the Identity Foundations team. The service validates internal session credentials.
Identity Foundations maintains the Solstice cache service for production session metadata.
For the production Solstice cache service, validated session metadata is cached for ten minutes.
For Solstice staging, validated session metadata is cached for two minutes.
Security Platform maintains the Meridian signing service for production API credentials.
For the production Meridian signing service, signing keys rotate every twelve hours.
For Meridian development, signing keys rotate every two hours.
Atlas deployment snapshots are created once per day for rollback support.
Developer Productivity also maintains internal build tooling for release automation.
